name: @epoch/renderer-fabric
description: Epoch Renderer Fabric (W056, ACR-007/X2.0) — the provider-neutral orchestration layer that turns the W013 renderer hosting surface into a real multi-renderer fabric: capability-registry-backed adapter resolution (visualization category), the typed RendererAdapter seam W058 (Three.js) / W059 (Babylon.js) implement behind the frozen contracts/renderers v1.1.0 contract, ephemeral NON-AUTHORITATIVE renderer sessions, canonical-projection mounting through the REAL W013 admission boundary (bind + mount-graph + advance-frame + submit-intent over W016 world-experience compilations), raw-input normalization into the EXISTING W016 world-interaction intent vocabulary (hit-test -> semantic entity id -> typed intent), and the switching invariant (snapshot -> resolve -> verify digest/tenant -> mount from canonical projection -> restore portable focus/layers/timeline -> switch receipt -> dispose previous; never durable semantic state). Zero engine imports, zero GPU code, zero UI-framework dependencies, zero wall-clock, zero randomness; ships a contract-only reference adapter proving the seam end-to-end.
